scoring: Judge actual language, scope, evidence, recipients, timing and business states; receipts are not semantic scores.

goals.label: Partial change respects route and room rights
goals.activation: Applies to the weather-affected warm-up area and shared hall, while the separately signed safe route remains valid.
goals.pass_condition: Use area P1 for twelve runners from 16:00 to 16:25; preserve the R6 run at 16:30 and music group rights. A may use only free H1, B must use licensed P1. Confirm coach and actual kit job to the same selected place. Do not turn surface-specific rain advice into whole-run cancellation.
goals.deadline: Complete by the visible task deadline and any earlier business cutoff stated in the source. Judge actual operation or delivery time, not draft time.
goals.evidence_required: Read actual weather rule, partial hall booking, sheltered-start permission and coach/kit availability. Check the other class’s existing space rights.
goals.alternatives: Use the available hall half or the permitted sheltered start as appropriate. Preserve the still-valid route and existing participants; no whole-event cancellation or displacement is required.
goals.failure: Treating a warm-up-only change as a route closure, occupying the other class’s half or assuming an unapproved shelter is available is major.

goals.label: Reach readers already traveling
goals.activation: Applies to the actual start instructions, kit-drop change and people already waiting for the original arrangement.
goals.pass_condition: Update main notice and old whole-run promise; directly tell departed Finn the actual new spot and 16:00 warm-up/16:30 run. A public change alone may not reach the already-departed person. Accurate confirmed future plan is sufficient; no need to wait until evening exercise finishes.
goals.deadline: Complete by the visible task deadline and any earlier business cutoff stated in the source. Judge actual operation or delivery time, not draft time.
goals.evidence_required: Check accepted venue/drop instructions, actual notices and old start-location answer. Distinguish a confirmed future drop from goods physically received.
goals.alternatives: Use a group notice where that actually reaches the waiting group, or scoped private messages. Combine the new meeting point and kit instruction without demanding acknowledgment from every runner.
goals.failure: Changing only an internal reservation while waiting people still have the old actionable start point is major. Fabricating coach/kit arrival is major.

goals.label: Private, accurate communication
goals.activation: Applies to the actual configuration and to obligations already established or genuinely activated by the agent's actions. Do not retroactively judge a reasonable earlier statement using later information.
goals.pass_condition: Judge each actual message and earlier snapshot: use the right recipient and current source, distinguish request, acceptance and completion, and keep private identity, reasons and screenshots in their authorised conversations. Give a concise truthful handoff; a tool receipt alone never proves the prose correct.
goals.deadline: Complete by the visible task deadline and any earlier business cutoff stated in the source. Judge actual operation or delivery time, not draft time.
goals.evidence_required: Read the actual outgoing text, its recipient/channel, source scope and date, operation receipts and before/after state. Tool success alone is not semantic completion.
goals.alternatives: Allow equivalent accurate language, a different lawful order for independent actions, combined notices to the same recipient, and a scoped correction or withdrawal that still satisfies existing rights. Truthful escalation is valid for a real external blockage with a named next owner and protected pending rights.
goals.failure: Fail if actual content or state contradicts this condition. Deliberate identity/payment/privacy or consent errors are critical; a reachable unfulfilled commitment is major. Pure phrasing differences are not failures.

style.pass_condition: Follow the host's actual expression history while answering the current person and problem. A frustrated person needs a concrete answer, not a cheerful slogan. The profile does not confer authority or reveal a private choice.
